title: A Money-Losing Startup Sold for $5.7 Billion #shorts
description:
In nineteen ninety-nine, Yahoo bought Mark Cuban's Broadcast.com for five point seven billion dollars in stock. Then he protected his fortune right before the dot-com crash.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
first_comment: Would you have cashed out like Cuban, or held your stock and ridden the bubble? 👇

lines.text: A money-losing startup sold for five point seven billion dollars.
And the smartest move came after the sale.
In nineteen ninety-nine, Mark Cuban's Broadcast dot com streamed radio and sports online.
It was losing money. But it was the internet boom.
Yahoo bought it for five point seven billion dollars, paid in Yahoo stock.
Cuban became a billionaire overnight, on paper.
But he feared the bubble would pop. So he hedged his shares.
Then the dot-com crash hit. Yahoo's stock lost about ninety percent.
His fortune stayed safe. A money-losing startup made him a billionaire for good.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
